lesson.title: How the pieces connect
lesson.summary: Modular applications connect pieces together by importing UI components and database functions into pages. This lets individual pages build structured layouts and fetch data cleanly.
lesson.analogy: Like assembling a pre-built house from modular furniture boxes and plumbing kits: you bring specialized parts into each room, but the instructions don't show how every factory made them.
details: Trace a module dependency and explain what crosses that boundary.
The customers page imports card UI components from '@/components/ui/card'.
The dashboard main page imports products data handlers and UI tabs.
tradeoffs: These source excerpts cannot prove how database queries execute at runtime or how authentication guards every route boundary.
